articles.description: There's nothing like a World Cup to put young stars in the shop window! With that in mind, ESPN has assembled a list of all the Socceroos' post-tournament transfers, all in one place.

articles.headline: UEFA to discuss World Cup boycott over FIFA private investment plan - sources
articles.description: UEFA is set to hold an emergency meeting this week, sources told ESPN, to discuss plans, including a potential World Cup boycott, to oppose a FIFA proposal to raise $20 billion from a sale of equity to outside investors.

articles.headline: Andy Burnham joins critics of FIFA's World Cup private investment plan
articles.description: Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said "football does not belong to investors" as he joined the criticism of FIFA's plan to set up a new private company to run the World Cup and other competitions.
